evidence_items.explanation: The report documents substantial unsolved reasoning tasks across Claude, Gemini, and Grok systems. It supports shared limitations, but does not establish every listed failure category across dozens of attempts or precisely known training-distribution shifts.
The paper studies distribution shifts in a controlled environment using small models. Its findings cannot alone establish the behavior of Grok, Claude, Gemini, or every contemporary frontier model.

evidence_items.publisher: Álvaro Cabezas-Clavijo and Pavel Sidorenko-Bautista / arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: This small bibliographic test found no fabricated references for two systems, although other reference errors remained. It cautions against a uniform task-by-task interpretation of invariably, without demonstrating a general solution to hallucination or distribution shift.

The controlled distribution-shift study does not test the named frontier systems.
The benchmark evidence supports shared weaknesses but cannot settle the full invariably and never wording.
